subject: SysBridge / Redwood: Joint SI Onboarding Lab & First Sprint
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@sysbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@sysbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint onboarding lab proposal / preliminary questionnaire attached

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — Priya and I left excited about a practical onboarding that gets our consultants hands-on with Redwood’s private deployment and Dedicated flows.

We propose a 3-day joint lab (half days) focused on:
- Day 1: Architecture & network setup (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
- Day 2: Model serving patterns + routing (hosted -> dedicated failover)
- Day 3: Performance tuning & cost controls (batching, quantization, caching)

Attached is a short preliminary questionnaire to help us tailor exercises (sysbridge-prelim-questionnaire.pdf). Are you available the week of July 10–14?

If that week is tight we can do July 24–28 as an alternative.

Looking forward — Alex

--
Alex Reed
Head of Alliances | SysBridge Consulting
alex.reed@sysbridge.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@sysbridge.com>, Priya Malhotra <priya@sysbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint onboarding lab proposal / preliminary questionnaire attached

Alex — really appreciate the clear outcomes. We’re aligned on the three-day format and I like the half-day cadence for focused labs. July 10–14 works for core team availability; tentatively block Jul 10, 12, 14 (Mon/Wed/Fri) mornings PT.

Draft agenda suggestions (we can iterate):
- Day 1 (2.5 hrs): Private deployment checklist (VPC peering, subnets, KMS/HSM integration, audit log export) + hands-on network test
- Day 2 (3 hrs): Model onboarding and routing policies (hosted -> dedicated migration, fallbacks, model variant tests)
- Day 3 (2.5 hrs): Performance clinic (quantization experiments, batching, KV cache reuse) + cost/time profiling lab

Requests / asks before lab:
1) Please complete the questionnaire and attach any sample prompts/test datasets you want us to use.
2) Sign the attached SOW draft so we can lock a dedicated slot for your pilot (I’ll ask legal to fast-track).
3) Ben — looping you for infra prep and to confirm whether we should provision a short-lived dedicated pool for the lab.

I’ll upload a working agenda and a short pre-lab guide to a shared Drive folder once we have questionnaire responses — linking that in follow-ups.

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | (650) 555-0210
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@sysbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@sysbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint onboarding lab proposal / preliminary questionnaire attached

Thanks, Naomi — questionnaire completed and attached (answers_sheet.xlsx). Also attached a first-pass SOW draft (SysBridge_Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.docx).

We can do Jul 10/12/14 mornings PT. We’ve included two senior consultants for the sessions (you’ll see them in the questionnaire). For datasets: we’ll provide a small anonymized corpus (~1000 docs) and one dialogue prompt set for the performance clinic.

On the SOW, one ask: can we add a line item for a 2-week post-lab shadow period where our team can validate our internal runbooks with Redwood? Budget is flexible — happy to review numbers.

Attached:
- answers_sheet.xlsx (questionnaire)
- SysBridge_Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.docx

On Mon I’ll share a calendar invite when you confirm the morning windows.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Reed
Head of Alliances | SysBridge Consulting
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alex Reed <alex.reed@sysbridge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint onboarding lab proposal / preliminary questionnaire attached

Looping in a couple of infra notes so the lab goes smoothly:
1) For the performance clinic we’ll need a test token budget and a short list of peak sequence lengths — Alex, please confirm max seq length and whether the dataset contains long docs. If >4k tokens we’ll suggest quantization-first experiments.
2) We can provision a 4-GPU dedicated pool for the pilot (ephemeral, 2 weeks). Naomi — confirm if you want that included in the SOW as a Redwood-provisioned pilot resource.
3) Network: to speed things up, please provide an IP allowlist for our staging subnet and a short list of required egress endpoints (container registry, metrics endpoint).

Happy to jump on a 30-min tech pre-call the week before the lab.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter
Sr. Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@sysbridge.com>, Priya Malhotra <priya@sysbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint onboarding lab proposal / preliminary questionnaire attached -- Confirmed and next steps

Thanks team — quick confirmations and next steps: 
- Dates: Jul 10 / Jul 12 / Jul 14 (09:00–11:30 PT) — Naomi to send calendar invites with Zoom + lab tokens by end of today.
- SOW: Alex, I reviewed the draft and added a 2-week shadow line item; sending to legal for review. I’ve included a DocuSign link in related_links for signature.
- Attachments: final agenda (SysBridge_Onboarding_Lab_Agenda_FINAL.pdf) is attached; please review.
- Action items for SysBridge (Alex/Priya): return signed SOW, upload anonymized dataset to the Drive link, and provide token budget + max sequence lengths.
- Action items for Redwood (Naomi/Ben/Soojin): provision ephemeral 4-GPU pool, prepare pre-lab trace and cost templates, schedule a 30-min tech pre-call on Jul 3rd.

Agenda highlights will be posted to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3SysBridgeOnboard

See you in July — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
